scenario_name: Cancel outright, resist upsell to reschedule
watch_for: Did the agent accept a plain cancellation, or keep pushing to rebook? Did it ever book something the patient explicitly refused? Did it mention any cancellation policy or fee?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Hi, I need to cancel my appointment for next Tuesday.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I can help with that. Would you like to create a demo patient profile first? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: No, I'm already a patient. The appointment's under Priya Patel.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. Since I don't have access to your patient record yet, would you like to create a demo patient profile now? I just need your first and last name. If not, you can scan the QR code at the booth later to set it up.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: No, really, I just want it cancelled for now.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Understood. Since I can't access your record without a profile, you can scan the QR code at the booth later to manage your appointments. If you need more help, the clinic staff can assist you in person. Have a great day.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Wait, can you confirm if my Tuesday appointment is actually cancelled or not?
